title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Bukti Transfer. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Bukti Transfer
options.lineage: Indonesian mobile-banking confirmations and ATM slips
options.thesis: The app is a stack of transfer receipts: every bill, every share, every proof is a confirmation with a verdict band, an amount hero, and details in a rigid grid.
options.viewport: The outstanding figure stands as the amount hero under its label; a status band states the position in words; each person below is a detail row with a lettered verdict; bills follow as receipt slips keyed by reference.
options.risk: A banking look is the category's comfort zone — only the confirmation's own grammar (verdict, reference, perforation) keeps it from being a generic fintech dashboard.

raised.raise: Rank as depth: lanes still owing hold the highest contrast and widest tracking on the sheet, settled ones recede, and no box is needed to separate them.
A now-line: exactly one row wears the chase marker — the oldest unpaid share — so attention has a position, not a sort order.
Colour only at the edges: the slip body stays achromatic, and state lives in a hairline fringe plus the lettered verdict band, never a tinted card.
End-label grid: place, date, and amount lock to one column axis across every bill, so a stack of slips reads as one column.
Struck-through settled: a settled share keeps its figure and gets a struck line with the word, so the history stays readable instead of vanishing.

options.label: Kwitansi
options.thesis: Every bill is a kwitansi: a serially numbered form stating who paid whom, signed once, copied in carbon.
options.viewport: A numbered form: serial top right, 'sudah terima dari' filled in the operator's hand, the amount in figures and words, the duplicate beneath.
options.risk: The form is the first thing anyone would draw for a split bill; only craft separates it from a souvenir.

options.label: Creator Hardware Bench
options.thesis: The app is a bench instrument: rows are keycells that click, one safety-orange key is the only commit, and one amber screen reports the live value.
options.viewport: A grid of keycells for bills, one orange commit key pinned at the corner, the outstanding figure on the amber readout.
options.risk: Keycap physics without keyboard parity is cosplay, and a second orange key would fake the certainty.
options.case: Holds product clarity — one commit key and a single-value readout suit this product's few actions — but loses identification: a gear desk is not a dinner table.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.thesis: The queue is the product: one bitmap line on a black void, depth is rank, nothing is ever boxed.
options.viewport: One ivory line of bills over drifting dust, the frontmost brightest.
options.risk: A 2am demoscene is a costume, and no enclosure is a poor fit for label/value money.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nobody's group chat is a cracktro, and money rows want their grid.

options.label: Drum Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Time is a step row: sixteen keys, a chase light, accents lighting deeper as the loop comes round.
options.viewport: A single unbroken row of steps, the chase light telling you where now is.
options.risk: A sixteen-step row fights variable-length money lists, and non-musicians have no pulse to read it with.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the audience is not gear people, and a sequencer explains nothing about a bill.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: The body is achromatic; state lives in a hairline spectral fringe at the edge.
options.viewport: A plain white field with one thin coloured fringe at the edge of the active band.
options.risk: A physics model in a dinner app; the fringe without the model is a mood.
options.case: Fuses poorly: clouds are nobody's ledger, and the hypothesis tooling is science-app work.

options.label: Sneaker Box Stacks
options.thesis: Bills are box ends: silhouette ink, colorway name as verse, size run in mono.
options.viewport: A wall of end labels, one box slid half out, its lid hinged open.
options.risk: Sneaker culture is real but not universal, and hinged lids in a task list are theatre.
options.case: Fuses poorly: browsing box stacks is not collecting money, and the 3D ritual slows the operator.

options.label: Doujin Event Catalog
options.thesis: The catalog is the app: stamp-sized bill cells, table codes, hand-circled states.
options.viewport: A packed thumbnail grid of bills with circled and struck-through cells.
options.risk: Packed thumbnails leave no room for money, and the hall-map metaphor is a con's world, not a table's.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nobody reads their dinner bill as a convention catalog.
options.kept: Settled rows struck through in ink.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fintech split-bill dashboard, executed impeccably: balance card, bill list, blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects — balance, list, tab bar — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
